training_through: public validation labels through 2026-10-04; intended for post-cutoff/live production

chronological_refit_experiment.method: train on dev + first half of validation; calibrate on next quarter; evaluate on final quarter

alternative_model_benchmarks.conclusion: Additional algorithms/capacity did not consistently beat the market-structured V8 champion; recent-data refit was the more robust improvement.

warning: Do not rescore the V10 full-refit model on the public validation window as an unbiased test because those labels are now part of training. The locked 43.4074 score remains the honest official validation evidence.

chronological_full_ensemble_experiment.notes: Both systems calibrated only on the preceding chronological block; V10 uses a neutral 50/50 direct-vs-spread centre and no static P50 intercept, then learns the live blend from settled outcomes.
